key_insight: Two-level overlapping Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and RGDSW coarse spaces remain robust for high-order 2D Poisson discretizations, while RGDSW significantly shrinks the coarse problem size.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable preconditioning strategy for high-order FEM/VEM solvers, helping keep iteration counts stable as polynomial order increases.
method: Build two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with overlap.
Use GDSW or reduced GDSW coarse spaces for P_k, Q_k FEM and VEM.
Derive condition-number bounds with explicit dependence on polynomial degree k.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests on structured triangular/quadrilateral FEM meshes and polygonal VEM meshes show scalable performance up to k=9, with RGDSW cutting coarse dimension by about 3x while keeping competitive iterations.
watch_item: The reported robustness is shown for the 2D Poisson model problem, so performance on more complex PDEs or 3D geometries still needs validation.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 2D
